integrity: The tree identities are proved analytically by unique-geodesic case analysis and a common-coin coupling; the sparse-graph limit invokes the published fixed-repetition local-convergence theorem with uniform finite-depth moment control. The standalone standard-library checker supports, rather than substitutes for, these arguments.
scientific_limitations: Exact two-round kernel only for initial trees; three-round branching defect on an explicit same-order pair of five-vertex trees; random-graph law at fixed positive c and p only; no full third-round classification or convergence rate.
title: Two-round radiality and a sharp third-round branching defect in stochastic triadic closure
